A2_distribution_shift_abstention.note: cross-group calibration decides whether the justification model may be deployed off the population it was fit on; abstention is the warden rule.

part_B_injected_override_on_real_choices.note_clean: On clean real data this is behavioural variation, NOT override -- there is no agent and no counterfactual. It is a monitor floor, not a harm measurement.
part_B_injected_override_on_real_choices.note_B: Override here is injected onto real human choices and labelled; the justification floor recovers the unjustifiable injected accepts far better than a random-equal count cap, on the real choice distribution.
